mechanism: For every printed original native failure, AU GetParameter's actual normalized value is exactly the projection obtained by storing the correctly clipped normalized Float32 endpoint in the pulse-width physical range and inversely normalizing it. Only CP_pw lanes fail; these have an affine 0.5..0.9 physical range (skew 1). This establishes normalized→physical Float32→normalized Float32 loss as the native publication defect; it does not attribute the difference between architectures to a particular compiler instruction.
projection_caveat: The physical numbers are projections from normalized values, not direct reads of internal parameter storage. Pinned JUCE source proves that storage/getter path; the independent native round-trip projection matches every printed failing AU readback exactly.
